name: Instagram Field
description: Provides a field that displays recent Instagram posts.
project_description:
This module allows to use your recent Instagram post as a field in your content type (or paragraph type) using the Instagram Basic Display API, updates when cache timeout is reached. Images and links are cached on your server.

 Configuration (1.7 and later) 
 
 Navigate to Administration > Extend and enable the instagram_field module 
 Navigate to Administration > Configuration > Services > Instagram Field 
 Register a new app at https://developers.facebook.com My Apps > Create App > Instagram: Set up > Products toolbar: Instagram Basic Display > Create New App 
 Copy "Instagram App ID" and "Instagram App Secret" to Instagram Field settings and save 
 Copy "OAuth redirect URI" from Instagram Field Settings to "Valid OAuth Redirect URIs" 
 Add your Website URL to "Deauthorize Callback URL" and "Data Deletion Request URL" 
 Roles -> Roles -> Instagram Testers -> Add Instagram Testers: your Instagram accountname 
 8. Press "Authenticate" button to authenticate and get an access token 
 
 Read README.md for more information.
